本卡其余部分不变，仍由本卡负责：名称列冻结、其余列横向滚动、滚动条保持可见、窄宽度下页头的处理。「任何宽度下数据单元格都不被固定列遮住」这条验收保留。

补一个实测：这个问题不开 AI 面板也会出现。1167 宽窗口里面板关着时，最后一列「预计成交日期」显示成「2027年1月4E」，底部合计的前半截也被压住。

Claim amendment · 2026-11-19T15:12Z (seat 5, area ux-1; amends claim 7010345426):
- File surface ADDS `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewPageHeader.tsx` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/PageHeader.tsx` and their tests. The list header is drawn there, not in `ObjectView.tsx`, which only passes props (dev report 7013125712). The new rule is opt-in from the list page, since `PageHeader` is shared by other console pages.
- Scope of the header half: at narrow width the list header drops its description, and 「导入」 keeps folding into 「更多」 (objectui#12705 already does this). Add a Playwright header pin plus a wide CONTROL, and ablate it. The same branch and PR #35552 then carry the whole card, and the body flips to `Fixes #35446`.
- Open-PR file scan: no open PR touches either file. `check-prior-rulings --terms "page header,header description,import overflow" --paths <both files>` → 0 hits.
- Noted, not in this round: a grouped list still pins Actions to the right over its shared scroller. It was not reproduced in a browser; if it reproduces, it gets its own card.
